# Quillwend launch plan

Owner: Maya (product lead) · Last edited: 2026-09-14

## Launch date

Public launch is **Tuesday 3 November 2026**. App-store submissions go in two weeks earlier, on
20 October, so a slow review cannot push the date.

## Milestones

- 2026-10-06: feature freeze. Offline sync v2 is in; shared streaks ship behind a flag.
- 2026-10-13: release candidate to the internal beta group (40 testers).
- 2026-10-20: app-store submissions (iOS and Android).
- Launch day: blog post, newsletter to the waiting list, press kit goes public.

## Go / no-go criteria

1. Zero open sync bugs rated "data loss".
2. Crash-free sessions above 99.5% in the beta group for seven days in a row.
3. The refund policy and the support FAQ are published.

The go / no-go call happens at the release-candidate review on 2026-10-13. Maya decides; Tomas
has a veto on anything touching sync.
